description: RoTerminal’s plans and prices, cheapest first: what each gives through an AI (calls a day) and in RoBot (about how many answers a month, an estimate), the one the person is on, and today’s calls used. Use it when they ask about plans, prices or limits, or after plan_upgrade_required. `upgrade` gives them a link to pay. Free to call: it never counts against the day’s calls.
